name: Promax Power Limited
summary: Promax Power Limited is an engineering firm that specializes in the comprehensive, end-to-end execution of diverse infrastructure projects. Its extensive portfolio encompasses power generation, substations, transmission lines, hydroelectric developments, distribution networks, and widespread electrification initiatives. The company also undertakes significant civil construction work, including pre-engineered and high-rise buildings, alongside crucial water management systems such as sewerage and water treatment plants. Established in 2004 by Vishal Bhardwaj, the firm is headquartered in Mohali, India.
